options.name: account_subsystem
options.description: When I(state=present), for local filesystems, specifies whether the file system is to be processed by the accounting subsystem.

options.name: attributes
options.description: When I(state=present), specifies comma separated 'attribute=value' pairs used to create or modify the local filesystem. Refer to 'crfs' AIX command documentation for more details on the supported attributes.

options.name: auto_mount
options.description: Specifies whether to automatically mount the filesystem at system restart while creating or updating filesystem.

options.name: device
options.description: When I(state=present), for local filesystem, it specifies the logical volume to use to create the filesystem. If not specified, a new logical volume will be created. When I(state=present), for NFS filesystem, it specifies the remote export device to use to create or modify the filesystem.

options.name: filesystem
options.description: Specifies the mount point that is the directory where the file system will be mounted.

options.name: fs_type
options.description: Specifies the virtual filesystem type to create the local filesystem.

options.name: mount_group
options.description: Specifies the mount group to be set/modified for a filesystem.

options.name: nfs_sec_methods
options.description: List of security methods to be used when attempting mount.

options.name: nfs_server
options.description: Specifies a Network File System (NFS) server for NFS filesystem.

options.name: nfs_soft_mount
options.description: Creates a soft mount, which means the system returns an error if the server does not respond.

options.name: nfs_version
options.description: Specifies the NFS version to be used during NFS mount.

options.name: permissions
options.description: Specifies file system permissions while creation/updation of any filesystem. C(rw) specifies read-write mode. C(ro) specifies read-only mode.

options.name: rm_mount_point
options.description: When I(state=absent), specifies to remove the mount directory along with the entry in the filesystem.

options.name: state
options.description: Specifies the action to be performed on the filesystem. C(present) specifies to create a filesystem if it does not exist, otherwise it changes the attributes of the specified filesystem. C(absent) specifies to remove a filesystem.

options.name: vg
options.description: When I(state=present), specifies an existing volume group.
